{{Vanilla|Ruined Portal}}
A '''ruined portal''' generates as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its chest loot so that gold is not easily available before iron.

Compared to vanilla, the chest:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/ruined_portal.json}}</ref>
* rolls 10–12 times instead of 4–8;
* gives 2–8 raw gold instead of gold ingots, and no longer contains gold nuggets, blocks of gold, glistering melon slices, light weighted pressure plates or a bell;
* replaces the separate golden tools and armor with the pack's golden armor table (weight 80), enchanted randomly, so golden tools are no longer found;
* no longer contains flint or iron nuggets;
* uses the pack's own golden apple and golden carrot, and replaces the enchanted golden apple with the pack's [[Golden Apple#Enchanted variant|stronger golden apple]].
